name: Tailor Brands
tagline: Tailor Brands is an AI-driven brand identity platform that helps entrepreneurs and small businesses create logos, brand guidelines, and marketing materials. Users answer a few questions about their business and preferences, and the AI generates professional logo designs and a complete brand kit.
